newsitem.title: USA: Northern Kansas gas compressor work trims IT.
newsitem.headline: Northern Kansas gas compressor work trims IT.

text.p: Enron unit Northern Natural Gas said planned maintenance this week on two gas compressor stations in Kansas will cut about 25 million cubic feet per day of interruptible service but will not affect firm supply.
"We've knocked off alternate and interruptible services on the southern end of the system, but we are meeting all firm commitments," a company spokeswoman said Tuesday.
She said the company started allocating gas on Sunday and Monday, adding the work in the Hugoton area in western Kansas should last about four or five days.
